$comment: SONAR MODULE (pack: sonar) — targets bizapps-sonar (schema __mj_BizAppsSonar, entity prefix 'MJ_BizApps_Sonar: ', shapes + CHECK lists read from its migrations V202606121005 Initial_Schema). Seeds ONE engagement score model over the member spine so the Sonar app opens onto lived-in data: model + published version + band set + time windows + 6 factors + per-member Scores with factor contributions, quarterly ScoreHistory, band-crossing transitions, and recompute runs. DERIVE-NEVER-INVENT: every raw factor value is computed from facts other packs generated (attended registrations, active committee terms, enrollments+cert pursuits, failed/denied payments, NPS answers, advocacy actions) evaluated in windows relative to each snapshot date — so scores ride the same hidden engagement dial as everything else and rank-order truthfully (Bob scores below Elena by construction, not by pin). Slug is 'morecheese-engagement' — the Sonar demo clone already owns 'member-engagement-score'/'cheese-member-engagement'/'engagement' and ScoreModel.Slug is UNIQUE. Like the platform pack this is integration-grade data (__mj.Entity lookups in the preamble): it loads on real installs, not bare playgrounds. Model/version owner + publisher are the platform pack's staff users, so INSTALL_ORDER puts sonar AFTER platform.

model.name: Member Engagement Score
model.description: Composite engagement score for federation members: participation, service, learning, payment health, sentiment, and advocacy — the retention early-warning dial.

bands.label: At Risk
bands.description: Disengaged — renewal is in doubt without intervention.

bands.label: Engaged
bands.description: Highly engaged — advocates and volunteers live here.

factors.name: Event Attendance
factors.description: Attended event registrations in the trailing 12 months.

factors.name: Committee Service
factors.description: Active committee memberships as of the score date.

factors.name: Learning Activity
factors.description: Course enrollments plus certification pursuits started in the trailing 12 months.

factors.name: Payment Health
factors.description: Failed or denied payments in the trailing 12 months (inverted — fewer problems scores higher).

factors.name: Survey Sentiment
factors.description: Mean post-conference NPS response over the trailing 24 months (0–10 scaled to 0–100).

factors.name: Advocacy Participation
factors.description: Advocacy actions taken in the trailing 24 months.

sonar.$factorNote: weights sum to 100; normalized factor = min(raw, cap)/cap*100 (invert flips it; survey-sentiment uses scale ×10 instead of a cap). Missing data → NeutralMidpoint 50 with MissingDataApplied=1.

snapshots.$note: quarterly recompute history; the last snapshot IS the current Score, the one before it feeds PreviousNormalizedScore/Delta/Trend
